provenance: 180 newly authored synthetic utterances in 60 scenario groups, with parallel TR/EN/DE versions; not private transcripts or real-user validation. Frozen before semantic comparison; held out from v1 prototypes. Native-language expert labels have not been independently verified.
splitPolicy: Group by scenario, keeping all translations together. Train=36, dev=36, test=108. Confidence thresholds selected only on dev.
